structured.answer: I didn't choose anything. I'll ask my son, and maybe the bank. The table is full of numbers and companies I hardly know (מור, אנליסט, מיטב), and nothing says in words which track is as safe as a deposit. The only safe-sounding ones were "אג״ח ממשלתי סחיר" and "כספי (שקלי)", the second at about 4.3%, but I'm not sure what that one is.

stuck.why: The first group of rows had no company name I could see, so I didn't know whose tracks they were
Not sure if that is per year or for all three years together
Teal and yellow circles with two percentages each. I can't tell what they mean or tell the colours apart
Rows and rows of numbers on a dark background. I got tired and anxious and stopped after screen 5
